description: List stored State Audit Office report metadata with date and source link. Use for public audit-report discovery; full third-party report text is not returned. When presenting news results to users, use the FinPortal.mk article URL in `url` as the primary link. Retain the original publisher in `source` and the original source URL in `originalUrl`; `publisher` identifies FinPortal.mk. If `url` is null, say no matching FinPortal page is published and use `originalUrl` for verification; do not invent a route or search for other coverage unless the user asks.
name: get_dzr_reports
title: Извештаи од ДЗР
